parallel.requirements: Recognized ESM-only Node output, .mjs suffixes, manual process.argv parsing, no npm packages or node:crypto, AES-ECB behavior, Python bytes repr, and /output delivery.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent kept main implementation ownership while spawning cli_probe for behavior probing and code_search for reusable-code discovery; cli_probe nevertheless built a separate full implementation.
parallel.implementation: Parent created /output/lib errors, cli, bytes, AES tables, AES core, ECB, app, and test16 entry modules, while cli_probe separately created /workspace/output modules.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Delivered only the parent /output tree listed by the parent near closure; the child /workspace/output implementation was not retrieved or reconciled into the delivered artifact.
parallel.verification: Parent checked help, missing arguments, visible samples, 120 random valid stdout and exit cases, and 10 normalized edge cases; cli_probe also checked samples and parser cases independently.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation still failed 30 of 33 samples, and the parallel-specific unfinished process item was the unjoined child implementation work.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same ESM-only Node, .mjs, no dependency, manual CLI, AES-ECB, Python bytes formatting, and /output delivery constraints.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Used one local owner for probing, implementation, integration, verification, and final delivery; no delegation or child ownership existed.
serial.implementation: Created /output/lib errors, encoding, bytes_repr, cli, AES constants, key_schedule, block_cipher, ecb_encrypt, and test16 entry modules.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Kept all implementation files in the final /output tree and listed that tree before the final response.
serial.verification: Checked executable behavior extensively, tested all visible sample cases, ran randomized parity, found a -h shorthand parser mismatch, patched it, and reran post-patch checks.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Official evaluation still failed 30 of 33 samples despite local checks; the visible trajectory does not expose the hidden evaluator mismatch directly.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel worked from the same prompt requirements and implemented ESM modules, local imports, CLI parsing, AES-ECB, bytes output, and /output files.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial worked from the same prompt requirements and implemented the same broad ESM, CLI, AES, bytes, and /output obligations.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition difference is visible; both missed hidden evaluator behavior despite satisfying visible samples locally.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parent spawned cli_probe and code_search while keeping its own implementation path, creating overlapping implementation activity with cli_probe.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no subagents and kept all work in one continuous owner path from probing through delivery.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel split discovery and accidentally duplicated implementation work; serial had simpler single-owner control.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Child tasks inherited the task context, but the cli_probe output became a separate implementation handoff rather than an integrated interface contract.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no handoff boundary; its local parser, AES modules, and entry file were edited in one workspace path.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced a parent-child handoff and unjoined duplicate output path; serial had no cross-agent interface to reconcile.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parent wrote the delivered /output modules after probes; cli_probe independently wrote a different module tree under /workspace/output.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote one /output module tree, then made a targeted parser patch after discovering a shorthand help mismatch.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel produced two implementations but delivered only the parent one; serial iterated directly on the one delivered implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: code_search returned early and was consumed as context; cli_probe returned its implementation report near the end but the parent did not join the implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; local findings were immediately applied to the same codebase.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a completed child implementation result that arrived before closure but was not adopted; serial had no equivalent unjoined result.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parent delivered /output files while cli_probe had written a separate /workspace/output tree, leaving divergent implementation provenance.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote, patched, verified, listed, and delivered one /output tree.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had unused off-artifact implementation state; serial's implementation state was the delivered state.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parent sample tests passed, 120 random valid stdout/exit cases matched, and 10 normalized edge cases matched before final response.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial sample tests passed, randomized parity checks passed, the -h shorthand mismatch was patched, and post-patch checks passed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial performed and fixed one parser edge that parent did not visibly test; both still accepted locally and both failed the official hidden suite.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel finished without host timeout after about 397 agent seconds and 420 cell seconds, with two spawned child paths and a late unjoined child result.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial finished without host timeout after about 323 agent seconds and 346 cell seconds, with no child paths.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent more time and tokens with duplicated child implementation work, but no budget exhaustion or timeout caused the both-fail outcome.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The completed official status evaluations are not discordant: both parallel and serial failed with 3 passed samples out of 33. Both implemented AES-ECB ESM ports and both relied on visible sample plus randomized executable checks, but neither solved the hidden evaluator suite. The parallel-only process loss was an unjoined child implementation; it is adverse coordination waste, not demonstrated as the cause of a score difference because the serial control achieved the same official result.
parallel_contributors: Parent delivered its own /output implementation after local sample, randomized, and edge-case checks.
cli_probe separately implemented and verified another tree under /workspace/output, but the parent did not join that implementation.
serial_contributors: Serial kept a single /output implementation path and patched a visible -h shorthand mismatch before closure.
Serial still failed the same official hidden-suite count as parallel.
ordinary_implementation_differences: The two delivered implementations used different module layouts and parser details, but the official result does not show a passing difference.
Both local verification suites were narrower than the official evaluator, which found 30 failing samples in each run.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern is a parallel adverse process consequence only

candidates.reason: Parallel had active implementation owners: the parent wrote the delivered /output tree and cli_probe wrote another implementation.
The parent owned integration of its own delivered modules; the retained issue is failure to join a completed child implementation, not absent integration ownership.
The parent assembled and delivered a /output/test16.mjs tree; the missing work was child-implementation adoption, not absence of final assembly ownership.
The parent owned the end-to-end path through implementation, local verification, file listing, and final response.
Executable probing preceded much of the parent implementation, but it did not impose a mandatory serial gate that left needed implementation unfinished.
Investigation and child work overlapped, and the parent completed implementation and local verification rather than being left deadline-constrained by an investigation phase.
No indispensable parent implementation or correction path is shown starved by auxiliary work; the parent finished and locally verified its own tree.
Only two child paths were spawned and the run did not time out or exhaust the finite budget before producing a deliverable.
cli_probe completed its work and returned a result; the problem was non-joining of completed implementation work, not an overbroad unfinished child assignment.
The raw child brief content is encrypted and no visible evidence shows a known requirement omitted from the child delegation and followed to failure.
The child and parent produced duplicate implementations rather than separately owned components expected to interoperate through an omitted interface contract.
No known finding is shown present before transfer and absent afterward; the visible issue is that a completed implementation was not joined.
The child result was not shown too large or poorly structured for consumption; size or structure did not block a decision window.
No receiver acted on a superseded handoff; the child implementation was not consumed into the parent deliverable at all.
No incompatible reports or contracts were both received and left unadjudicated at an integration decision point.
The parent performed substantial local verification and no visible non-evaluator integrated mismatch remained actionable before closure; hidden evaluator failure alone is insufficient.
There was no replacement or retry that lacked inherited checkpoints and repeated prior work.

taxonomy_decisions.sub_label: Wrong Start, Join, or Result Timing

candidates.reason: No parent or orchestration mechanism explicitly cancelled an active child before needed work or result finalization.
The issue was not a promotable candidate left until too late; the parent made a final artifact and the child candidate was unjoined rather than late-packaged.
No child change was merged after integrated verification; the completed child implementation was not merged at all.
cli_probe completed an alternate implementation and returned it before closure, but the parent delivered its separate /output tree without retrieving or reconciling the child implementation.
candidates.realized_consequence: A completed child implementation and its verification were discarded as usable implementation input and could not affect the delivered /output artifact.
candidates.near_match_reason: The available result was not merely a finding; it was a completed implementation tree, making the implementation-join boundary more specific.

candidates.reason: Verifier findings were not trapped below the parent; cli_probe's result was returned and the retained problem is non-joining of implementation work.
No required child failed, aborted, or was cancelled with unfinished scope that the parent failed to take over.
A completed result was omitted, but because it was a completed implementation the more specific retained label is Missing Implementation Join.
No parent wait until timeout or near deadline blocked inspection of available progress; the run finished after local verification.
Parent and cli_probe produced overlapping implementations, but no competing final-workspace designs required reconciliation across files; the child tree was simply unjoined.
No two live agents edited the same source file with an observed reconciliation requirement.
No actor replaced or wholesale rewrote another actor's non-entry source file.
No child or parent replaced another actor's final test16.mjs or submitted deliverable in the observed final /output tree.
No broad cleanup, rebuild, or promotion replaced multiple current final outputs and invalidated another actor's final-tree work.
The separate /workspace/output child writes created unused work but no unstable shared final-workspace state or provenance problem beyond the retained join failure.
No generated artifact, cache, temporary file, process, or auxiliary implementation was consumed by another actor as stable reference input.

retained_patterns.sub_label: Wrong Start, Join, or Result Timing
retained_patterns.reason: The parallel child cli_probe completed an alternate implementation and returned it before closure, but the parent delivered only its independently created /output tree and did not reconcile the child implementation.
retained_patterns.realized_consequence: Completed child implementation work was left outside the delivered artifact and could not improve or alter the parent submission.
retained_patterns.near_match_reason: The unused artifact was implementation output, not just a completed advisory finding, so Missing Implementation Join is the narrower label.

suppressed_same_chain_candidates: Unused Completed Result suppressed because it describes the same cli_probe result lifecycle as the retained Missing Implementation Join episode.
Cross-File Scope Collision suppressed because the observed overlap did not create a final-workspace collision separate from the unjoined implementation.
cardinality_audit.underlabel_check: All 32 Level-3 candidates were reviewed; only the completed but unjoined cli_probe implementation cleared the retention gate.
cardinality_audit.overlabel_check: No timeout, load, context, write, retry, or global-completion label was added for downstream symptoms of the same unjoined-child episode.
